mapper.insert: insert into sys_plant ( sys_id, plant_cd, plant_nm, use_yn, delete_yn, insert_datetime, insert_user_id, emp_nm, phone_number, reg_num ) values ( #{signUpRequest.sysId}, #{signUpRequest.businessRegiNum}, #{signUpRequest.plantNm}, 'Y', 'N', now(), #{signUpRequest.userId}, #{signUpRequest.userNm}, #{signUpRequest.phoneNumber}, #{signUpRequest.businessRegiNum} )

insert into sys_user ( sys_id , user_id , user_nm , user_password , email , email_valid_yn , init_yn , password_fail_cnt , delete_yn, insert_user_id , insert_datetime, sys_plant_cd ) values ( #{signUpRequest.sysId}, #{signUpRequest.userId}, #{signUpRequest.userNm}, #{signUpRequest.userPassword}, #{signUpRequest.email} , 'N', 'N', 0, 'N', #{userId}, now(), #{signUpRequest.businessRegiNum} )
insert into sys_email_valid ( sys_id , link_sys_id , encode_sys_id , valid_code , email_valid_yn , insert_datetime ) values ( #{sysId}, #{linkSysId}, #{encodeSysId}, #{validCode}, 'N', now() )
mapper.select: select count(*) > 0 from sys_user where 1=1 and user_id = #{userId} and delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: update sys_email_valid set email_valid_yn = 'Y', modify_datetime = now() where 1=1 and encode_sys_id = #{encodeSysId}
